caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical container positioned upright, centrally against a plain, light cream-colored background. The container is predominantly brown with a polished, metallic appearance and features a segmented design with vertical ridges running down its surface. The upper portion of the container is slightly tapered and has a beveled edge at the rim, while the lower portion appears more cylindrical with evenly spaced vertical groove detailing. The container's opening is circular and recessed, giving it a hollow look at the top. There are varying shades of brown throughout, indicating different light reflections and surface texture. Just below the container and slightly to the right, there is a small signature in reddish-brown text reading "C. B. Myers." No other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Jar
